detections.description: A soldier (right) holds another soldier's (left) head with both hands, pressing his face close in a coercive, non-consensual manner; the younger soldier shows distress and resistance across multiple frames.

The same two soldiers engage in physical struggle: the younger soldier pushes back, grimaces, and appears to be struck or shoved downward while the older soldier maintains control; surrounding soldiers observe but do not intervene.

A soldier in a U.S. uniform is seen repeatedly striking and dragging a kneeling, restrained German soldier on the ground while other soldiers observe; the victim appears helpless and unable to resist.

Two soldiers (one U.S., one German) are engaged in close physical struggle: the U.S. soldier grabs and lifts the German soldier, who resists briefly before being overpowered and brought to the ground.

A soldier (Brad Pitt) is restraining and subduing a younger soldier who is holding a revolver; the younger soldier appears distressed and helpless, with his arms being controlled and weapon disarmed over multiple frames without resistance or mutual combat.

Initial physical struggle where the younger soldier resists while holding the revolver, and the older soldier grabs and restrains him; visible tension and forceful contact suggest mutual engagement before subdual.
A soldier is being forcibly restrained and held down by another soldier while holding a pistol; the restrained soldier appears distressed and unable to resist, indicating abuse of a helpless victim.
A violent physical struggle occurs: one soldier grabs the other’s head/face while the latter raises a pistol in apparent resistance or counter-attack, indicating mutual combat.

A soldier is holding a pistol to the head of a kneeling, restrained individual while other soldiers observe; the restrained person shows visible distress and fear.; A soldier in a helmet is seen pointing a pistol directly at a kneeling, restrained man on the ground while other soldiers observe; the victim appears helpless and terrified.; Immediately after the shot, the shooter lowers the weapon while the victim remains on the ground, now visibly injured or incapacitated, with another soldier restraining him.
A soldier in a helmet lunges forward and strikes or shoves the restrained individual on the ground, who is being held by another soldier; the action involves direct physical contact and aggression.

In frame f2, the kneeling man appears to be struggling or resisting as he is held down by two soldiers; however, this is brief and ambiguous—primarily consistent with restraint rather than mutual combat. Given low confidence and ambiguity, this event is included but with caution.
At ~58.0s, a muzzle flash is visible from the pistol as it is fired at close range toward the kneeling man; the recoil and flash confirm discharge.
